submitted.rationale: XRD shows Cr2O3 plus a rutile mixture on the Cr-rich side (idx 4). The Sb-rich side is dominated by a rutile (Cr,Sb)O4-type phase whose reflection near Q~1.91-1.92 gets stronger with more Sb (idx 21 to 26). EQE went up steadily with Sb: idx21 0.045%, idx26 0.072%, idx27 0.076% (the end of the composition line). Idx 27 is the highest value measured.

rejected.reason: XRD shows mixed Cr2O3 (eskolaite) and rutile phases, so it is unlikely to be the best photoanode. Not measured for EQE.
Near the 1:1 CrSbO4 composition with only weak rutile peaks. The EQE trend points to Sb-rich compositions, so the merit budget went there instead.
Measured EQE 0.045%, below the Sb-richer samples.
